title: Canadian Yeast Gravy on Mushrooms
description: A savory and rich gravy made with Canadian yeast and served on top of sautéed mushrooms.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, mix together yeast and warm water to activate yeast.
2. In a separate pan, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté mushrooms until tender.
3. In a small saucepan, whisk together flour and gravy to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
4. Add the yeast mixture to the roux and whisk until smooth.
5. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes or until thickened.
6. Serve the Canadian yeast gravy over sautéed mushrooms.
7. If using oyster mushrooms, add them on top of the gravy for added flavor.
